sections.name: Arriving
sections.about: On top of the world: loading, first screen, home screen, Happening now, menus, HUD. Not here: which lobby you join (Social).

sections.name: Your character
sections.about: Your body and look: avatar, customizer, animation, poses, what you wear. Not here: buying outfits (Shops).

sections.name: The bar
sections.about: Shared places and their things: rooms, props, lights, mirrors, jukebox, the street. Not here: games in them (Games).

sections.name: Games
sections.about: What you play or work at (score, turn, win): darts, 4K Mania, racing, chess, piano, arcade, bartending, music studio.

sections.name: Social
sections.about: Other people: voice, profiles, lobbies, events, memory book, messages, safety. Not here: the voice servers (Server).

sections.name: Your home
sections.about: Your own place: grid placement, levels, expansion, invites. Not here: buying furniture (Shops).

sections.name: Shops & money
sections.about: Where money and items change hands: credits, the mall, casino, VIP, trading. Not here: the wallet itself (Accounts).

sections.name: Ideas
sections.about: No home yet. Once an idea has a home, the card moves there (stage Idea).

sections.name: Performance
sections.about: How fast and light it runs on the phone: frame time, memory, loading, quality settings.

sections.name: Engine & code
sections.about: Code structure with no visible change: the C++ core, ids, the activity system, cleanup.

sections.name: Multiplayer server
sections.about: The live shared room: what it decides and checks, the protocol, voice relays. Not here: data kept forever (Accounts).

sections.name: Accounts & ledger
sections.about: Kept forever per person: logins, ages, money, owned items, payments. Not here: spending it (Shops).

sections.name: Tests & tools
sections.about: How we work: tests, deploys, phone reports, this hub, the AI dock. Bugs go with the broken thing.
